en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a grand seafront hotel building with several balconies and an arched central façade, labeled at the top in red print "Crikvenica" on the left and "Gr. Hotel Miramare" on the right. In the foreground are trees, a garden path, and people walking or gathered in front of the hotel. The reverse side contains dense handwritten text in German, an address written in large cursive, a green postage stamp, postmark, and archival stickers or labels.
